claim_tested: Which family member is the physiological gamma-Glu-GABA hydrolase
key_finding: P. aeruginosa SpuA (PA0297) structure with glutamate bound; SpuA prefers gamma-Glu-GABA. KT2440 PP_2179 is the SpuA orthologue (69.6% identity, 14/14 pocket residues identical); PP_3598 is 42.8% identical with 11/14 pocket residues
confidence: high for SpuA; inference for KT2440 by orthology

claim_tested: Does PP_3598 carry diamine gamma-glutamyl hydrolase flux
key_finding: Triple knockout spuA/PP_3598/PP_5298 impaired but did not abolish growth on hexamethylenediamine; transaminase knockouts abolished it. PP_3598 upregulated in evolved strain NYL
context: P. putida KT2440, non-natural C6 diamine
confidence: medium; redundant triple KO cannot assign flux to one paralog
